reasoning: The icon is the standard automotive dashboard symbol for a ventilated or cooled car seat (and more broadly car cabin AC). It is very distinctive and recognizable to drivers, though its use in a personal to-do list is limited to a narrow set of vehicle maintenance, comfort, and car-shopping tasks.
